Given $\vec{a} = 4\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k}$, $\vec{b} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$.

First compute $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$:

$$\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \\ 1 & -2 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(3\cdot2 - 1\cdot(-2)) - \hat{j}(4\cdot2 - 1\cdot1) + \hat{k}(4\cdot(-2) - 3\cdot1)$$

$$= \hat{i}(6+2) - \hat{j}(8-1) + \hat{k}(-8-3) = 8\hat{i} - 7\hat{j} - 11\hat{k}$$

Now compute $\vec{a} \times (\vec{a} \times \vec{b})$:

$$\vec{a} \times (8\hat{i} - 7\hat{j} - 11\hat{k}) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \\ 8 & -7 & -11 \end{vmatrix}$$

$$= \hat{i}(3\cdot(-11) - 1\cdot(-7)) - \hat{j}(4\cdot(-11) - 1\cdot8) + \hat{k}(4\cdot(-7) - 3\cdot8)$$

$$= \hat{i}(-33+7) - \hat{j}(-44-8) + \hat{k}(-28-24) = -26\hat{i} + 52\hat{j} - 52\hat{k}$$

Next, compute $\vec{a} \times (\vec{a} \times (\vec{a} \times \vec{b}))$:

$$\vec{a} \times (-26\hat{i} + 52\hat{j} - 52\hat{k}) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \\ -26 & 52 & -52 \end{vmatrix}$$

$$= \hat{i}(3\cdot(-52) - 1\cdot52) - \hat{j}(4\cdot(-52) - 1\cdot(-26)) + \hat{k}(4\cdot52 - 3\cdot(-26))$$

$$= \hat{i}(-156-52) - \hat{j}(-208+26) + \hat{k}(208+78) = -208\hat{i} + 182\hat{j} + 286\hat{k}$$

Finally, compute $\vec{a} \times (\vec{a} \times (\vec{a} \times (\vec{a} \times \vec{b})))$:

$$\vec{a} \times (-208\hat{i} + 182\hat{j} + 286\hat{k}) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \\ -208 & 182 & 286 \end{vmatrix}$$

$$= \hat{i}(3\cdot286 - 1\cdot182) - \hat{j}(4\cdot286 - 1\cdot(-208)) + \hat{k}(4\cdot182 - 3\cdot(-208))$$

$$= \hat{i}(858-182) - \hat{j}(1144+208) + \hat{k}(728+624) = 676\hat{i} - 1352\hat{j} + 1352\hat{k}$$

Now $\vec{b} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$, so $676\vec{b} = 676\hat{i} - 1352\hat{j} + 1352\hat{k}$.
